player_note: The post (22 February 2000) mentions playing at "the NYC grand slam" ("i blew up EPP Han, EPP leia and Ben kenobi with a Bomarr monk at 2 different times"), but the list has no Bomarr Monk and gives no result, so it is filed as a general deck.
